name: ClickUp
one_liner: Project management platform; ClickUp API lets teams build custom workflows, integrations, and automations.
auth_notes: Personal API token in Authorization header; OAuth flow for apps that other users authorize per Workspace.
access_notes: Rate limits apply to FreeForever plan (100/min), so API is available on free plans; Enterprise gets 10,000/min and user management API.

buildability.rationale: API on all plans incl. FreeForever with 100 req/min; self-serve token and OAuth; OpenAPI spec and official MCP available.

auth.quote: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token.
For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.

api_surface.quote: These limits apply to both personal and OAuth tokens and vary by Workspace Plan of the Workspace hosting the token.
The raw OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API is available for each version of our Public API.

mcp.quote: ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans.
Our MCP server URL is https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp.

identity.quote: To use the ClickUp API, you must authenticate every request.

disputes.why: Rate limits listed for FreeForever plan; pricing shows 100/min API calls on lowest tiers.
Only higher rate limits are plan-dependent; API access is on all plans.
No credential gate; free plan has API.
Docs page gives actual server URL.
